property_summary: For any admin address, a low-level delegatecall of C.initialize into a fresh (zeroed) storage context must succeed, because the initializer modifier starts the initializing flag before the onlyInitializing child inits run; the mutant drops the modifier so __Access_init's onlyInitializing guard reverts NotInitializing for every input.
change_summary: Drop the initializer modifier so initialize no longer performs initialization-state checks (and now reverts because onlyInitializing child inits fail).
